'branded content' is rendered 브랜디드 콘텐츠 in the description and use cases but 브랜드 콘텐츠 here; keep one term across the page.

findings.reason: 'generation basics' means the basic generation settings, not 'default values' (기본값), which implies preset defaults.

The workflow name is kept as the English 'MiniMax: Video' throughout the description, metaDescription, extendedDescription and howToUse; translating only the title creates an inconsistent page-level name for the same workflow.
'durations' is rendered as the required UI term 재생 시간 everywhere else (metaDescription, extendedDescription, howToUse, FAQ); 길이 breaks the mandated terminology and internal consistency.
'high-quality' is translated 고품질 in metaDescription and extendedDescription; 고화질 here is inconsistent within the same entry.
Ungrammatical verb form; the noun 내보내기 cannot take 합니다 in this position in natural Korean.
'social images' should follow the required product-UI rendering 'Social media → 소셜 미디어'; 'SNS' deviates from the mandated terminology.
UI labels 'Queue' and 'Execute' have mandated Korean renderings (실행 대기열 / 실행) and were left untranslated.
'text-to-image' has a mandated rendering (텍스트에서 이미지로); a transliteration was used instead.

Adds 'automatically generates', while the English only says the user 'receives' the individual frames; also '등' adds an unstated 'etc.'
These animation names are translated into Korean in the description (대기, 공격, 걷기, 점프) but left in English here, creating inconsistency across the page.
Transliterated verb 'segment하다' is unnatural Korean; the same idea is rendered as 분할 later in the text.
UI term 'Customize' must be rendered as 사용자 정의 per the required glossary.

'enthusiasts' is flattened to the generic '사용자' (users), losing the intended meaning of hobbyists/enthusiasts.

"video" must be rendered as 비디오 per the required product-UI terminology; 영상 is used here while 비디오 is used elsewhere in the entry.
"내보내기 합니다" is ungrammatical noun+하다 construction; a native speaker would write 내보냅니다.
Uses "트림" while the rest of the page consistently uses "트리밍" for trim, an internal inconsistency.
"사후 편집" is not the standard Korean rendering of "in post"; 후반 작업 is the idiomatic term.
Product-UI term 'Preview' must be rendered as '미리보기', not transliterated as '프리뷰'.

findings.reason: Adds '내보내기 후' (after exporting), which is not in the English ('remux it afterward'); introduces a step the source does not mention.
'둘 다를' is awkward; a native speaker would omit the object particle here.

findings.reason: Awkward phrasing; the English means 'leave the other settings at their defaults for the first pass', which the current wording renders unclearly.
'Talent casting' is rendered as 탤런트 캐스팅 in the title and 탤런트 in the FAQ, but as 인재 캐스팅 here; the page should use one consistent term.
'Headshot' is translated as 인물 사진 in the metaDescription and FAQ but as 헤드샷 here (and in howToUse), an inconsistent rendering of the same source term within one entry.
Product-UI term 'preview' must be rendered 미리보기 (as done elsewhere in this entry), not 프리뷰.
Required translation for 'Filenames' is 파일 이름.
